summary: Satkari Sharma Vangiya is a scholar in Indology and linguistics who studied under traditional teachers Ramachandra Shastri Vyakaranacharya and Ramachandra Sastri (attested 1970).

Satoru Harada is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. After earning an M.A. from the University of Tokyo (attested 1973), he worked at Toyo Bunko, the Eastern Institute, and Kokushikan University, where he was professor (attested 2010–2015).
Satoru Noriyama works in Buddhist studies and studied under Esho Mikogami. He held teaching posts at Osaka University of Foreign Studies (attested 1995) and Ryukoku University (attested 2003, 2013).
Satoshi Fujiwara is a Buddhist studies scholar who served as a researcher at the Shinran Buddhist Center (attested 2015) and lecturer at the Otani Academic Society (attested 2026).
Satoshi Hayashima specializes in Buddhist studies. He was a research student at Ryukoku University (attested 2013–2014) and later served there as a lecturer (attested 2015–2017).

Satoshi Hiraoka is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at Bukkyo University and the University of Michigan. He taught at Bukkyo University (~1993–1999) before serving as professor (from 1996) and president (2014) at Kyoto Bunkyo University.
Satoshi Ito is a scholar of Japanology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. Educated at Waseda University (~1980–1989), he became a professor at Ibaraki University around 2004.
Satoshi Kono is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned a doctorate from the University of Tokyo. In 2000, he became a professor at Kogakkan University.

Satoshi Naiki specializes in history, archaeology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD from Kyoto University, where he later served as assistant professor (attested 2016–2020).
Satya Narayan Goenka worked in Buddhist and religious studies, having studied under Sayagyi U Ba Khin from circa 1955 to 1969. In 1985, he founded the Vipassana Research Institute.

Satya Swarup Misra was an Indology and linguistics scholar. He served as professor and head of Sanskrit at the University of Lucknow (attested 1958) and as professor of Indology and linguistics at Banaras Hindu University (~1970–1995).

Satya Vrat Shastri was a scholar of Indology and linguistics educated at the University of the Punjab and Banaras Hindu University. He held key posts at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and Shri Jagannath Sanskrit Vishvavidyalaya.

Satyanad Kichenassamy is a scholar in Indology and mathematics educated at École Normale Supérieure and Pierre and Marie Curie University. He held posts at the Courant Institute, University of Minnesota, University of Reims Champagne-Ardenne, and Paris Sciences et Lettres University.

Satyendra Nath Bose was an Indian academic educated at Presidency University and the University College of Science, Technology & Agriculture. He taught at the University of Calcutta and University of Dhaka, and served as vice-chancellor of Visva-Bharati University (~1956–1958).

Saurabh Singh is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies who earned degrees from Delhi University, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, and Deccan College. He held posts at Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (2022–2023) and Delhi University (2024).

Sayadaw U Pandita was a Buddhist studies figure who studied under Nandasiri Sayadaw and Mahasi Sayadaw. He taught at Mahasi Sasana Yeiktha, succeeded Mahasi Sayadaw (1982–1991), and served as abbot of the Panditarama Meditation Center, which he founded.

Sayadaw U Sīlānanda was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under U Paññāvanta and Mahasi Sayadaw. He held leadership posts at several monasteries, the Theravada Buddhist Society of America, and became chancellor of the International Theravāda Buddhist Missionary University in 1999.

Sayadaw U Thittila was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Ashin Adiccavamsa and at Visva-Bharati University. He served as librarian at the Adyar Library and the Buddhist Society, and became a lecturer at the University of Rangoon in 1952.
Sayagyi U Ba Khin was a teacher in Buddhist and religious studies who studied under Saya Thetgyi from circa 1937 to 1945. He also founded the International Meditation Centre.

Sayaka Sonoda specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology, earning a PhD from Toyo University under Shinobu Yamaguchi and Shogo Watanabe. In 2020, she held posts at the Cabinet Office and Toyo University.
